title: Localize task lifecycle and verification checklist
context: TasksScreen displays several Vietnamese-only lifecycle and verification checklist strings even when English is selected, and its dynamic task-state title is passed as String rather than LocalizedStringKey.
goal: Resolve task state, lifecycle steps, and reliability checklist labels through the selected app language.
forbidden_changes: Do not change task execution, cancellation, or result verification behavior.
Do not claim a durable job queue or audit log exists.
Do not alter runtime state or permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic task-state title is rendered through LocalizedStringKey.
Task lifecycle and reliability checklist strings have English and Vietnamese catalog entries.
Vietnamese values preserve the current on-screen wording.
No duplicate localization keys are introduced.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Static duplicate-key scan for both localization catalogs
recovery: Revert the single task commit if localization lookup or Apple build regresses.
